rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something excellent, great, or wonderful.

example.english: The food at this restaurant is really super.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use this specifically when praising the quality or standard of something rather than calling it generally wonderful.

example.english: The sound quality of these earphones is really super.
example.traditional: 呢部耳機嘅音質真係高質。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 ji5 gei1 ge3 jam1 zat1 zan1 hai6 gou1 zat1
